// Generated by Cairntrace `cairn export playwright`. Edit at your own risk —
// re-running export will overwrite. Source: /tmp/flows/strict.yml
// Intent: Locators fail on ambiguity instead of taking the first match
// Lang: ts

import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";

test("strict_locators", async ({ page }) => {
  // Derived from sequential step/outcome budgets (+10% headroom, at least 1m); 4h ceiling.
  test.setTimeout(300000);

  // --- steps ---
  // step: go
  await page.goto("https://example.com/form");
  // step: save
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }).click();
  // step: second_save
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }).nth(1).click();
  // step: email
  {
    for (let fillAttempt = 0; ; fillAttempt++) {
      await page.getByLabel("Email").fill("a@b.c");
      await page.waitForTimeout(500);
      try {
        await expect(page.getByLabel("Email")).toHaveValue("a@b.c", { timeout: 500 });
        break;
      } catch (err) {
        if (fillAttempt >= 3) throw new Error("hydration wiped value after 4 attempts", { cause: err });
      }
    }
  }
  // step: raw
  await page.locator("#plain").click();
  // step: plan
  await page.getByText("Pro plan").click();

  // --- outcomes (the contract) ---
  // saved: the toast says Saved
  await expect(page.locator("body")).toContainText("Saved", { ignoreCase: true, useInnerText: true });

  // on_form: still on the form
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp("^https://example\\.com/form"));

});
